pr.title: Skip symlink tests on Windows developer machines
pr.body:
## Skip symlink tests on Windows developer machines

Windows does not support symbolic links by default.  Tests fail for new contributors on Windows if they do not adjust their Windows configuration to allow symbolic links.

We want to allow developers running on Windows to easily disable tests that require symbolic links.  We want to always run the tests on Windows machines in our CI environment.

Amends pull request:

* https://github.com/jenkinsci/jenkins/pull/26203

New tests that depend on Windows symbolic links were added as part of the core tests for SECURITY-3657 in commit 6dc99937605d5.  The technique from pull request 26203 is too complicated for use in multiple modules.

This change simplifies the logic by using as Maven profile to set an environment variable for surefire when running tests.  This accepts that Windows developers running these tests in their IDE (without surefire) will either need to set the environment variable `DISABLE_SYMLINK_TESTS=true` or enable symbolic links.
